verdict.rationale: Authy's own docs state that codes remain accessible without internet on the phone, so offline code generation is documented. The 'no vendor account' half of the story is not met: Authy accounts are tied to a phone number, new devices are added via SMS or voice approval, and a community member describes the phone number as acting as a username. Missing for 10: any way to use Authy without a vendor account tied to a phone number, independent hands-on confirmation of fully offline generation, and detail on offline behavior across desktop and other devices.

support.subject: As a power user, codes generate fully offline — no network, no vendor account required just to see my TOTP codes

citations.quote: You can still access secured websites without internet access on your phone.
Add new devices with SMS, voice or existing device approval.
The phone number here just acts as a username.
